# Daily AI Native Product Radar - 2026-09-28

数据窗口：2026-09-25T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-28T15:56:58+08:00。GitHub Search API 查询最近创建或活跃更新的 AI agent、MCP、computer-use、browser automation、code agent、workflow、RAG/LLM app、assistant、copilot、video-agent 等方向，并对候选仓库做 repository/root/README audit。

信息来源：Queried GitHub Search API surfaces saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_28_api/ for recently created and recently pushed AI agent, computer-use, MCP, workflow, assistant, coding-agent, and video-agent repositories. Deduplicated candidates from valid search responses, then audited selected repository metadata, root contents, and README files under /tmp/radar_2026_09_28_readmes/. Some complex OR search URLs returned empty/error responses, so the final set combines successful GitHub Search API metadata with direct repo/root/README audits for shortlisted projects.

关键假设：Scores are based on live GitHub Search API metadata, repository descriptions/topics, stars/forks, created_at and pushed_at timing, root-content evidence, README docs, install/test/CI/release signals, and product-surface clarity. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, Windows-tested, phone-tested, MCP-connected, credential-tested, provider-tested, security-tested, payment-tested, or deployed locally. Star counts and pushed_at values are point-in-time metadata and can change quickly.

## 今日趋势观察

Today the strongest AI-native product signal is moving below the chat layer into execution substrate: isolated agent computers, persistent sandboxes, Linux/Windows/macOS computer-use MCPs, local coding-agent workbenches, task-contract GUI delegation, and self-verifying media agents. The best candidates make actions bounded, auditable, recoverable, or packaged as a real CLI/desktop/API workflow rather than only adding another prompt or skill collection.

## Top Projects

### 1. [arcboxlabs/arcbox](https://github.com/arcboxlabs/arcbox)
- 分类：isolated machines for AI agents
- AI Native Product Score：92
- 做什么：Rust platform for running AI agents on real isolated machines with their own kernel, filesystem, and network, positioned as local-first OCI-compatible microVM infrastructure.
- 面向谁：Agent platform teams and developers who need disposable, isolated execution environments for untrusted or stateful agent work.
- AI native 点：Treats the agent computer as an infrastructure primitive: fast-boot isolated machines with explicit filesystem and network boundaries instead of loose local shell access.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-28 with about 4,278 stars and 189 forks. Root audit found Cargo workspace, app, computer, engine, fleet, guest, runtime, sdk, virt, tests, docs, SECURITY, Makefile, Nix/dev environment, and agent instruction files.
- 可运行性判断：High from Rust workspace, SDK/runtime/virt structure, tests, docs, and security files; no microVM, OCI workflow, or agent workload was run locally.
- 建议动作：Prototype one disposable coding-agent task inside an isolated VM and compare boot time, filesystem reset, and network policy behavior against Docker-only sandboxes.

### 2. [CelestoAI/celesto](https://github.com/CelestoAI/celesto)
- 分类：secure persistent computers for agents
- AI Native Product Score：91
- 做什么：Secure persistent computer environment for AI agents that can run code, browse the web, use desktop apps, and expose Python/API workflows.
- 面向谁：Teams building agents that need durable browser/desktop/code state without handing the model an uncontrolled personal machine.
- AI native 点：Turns a computer for agents into a packaged runtime with OpenMuse, Python API, runtime choices, examples, docs, tests, CodeQL, and UI components.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-28 with about 987 stars. README audit shows quickstart, Python API, agents and automation, runtime docs, examples, CodeQL/test badges; root audit found celesto-core, guest-agent, kernel, open-muse, openapi, ui, tests, docs, scripts, pyproject, and Cargo files.
- 可运行性判断：High from docs, examples, tests, UI/openapi/runtime structure, and CI signals; no runtime, browser, desktop app, or agent automation was started.
- 建议动作：Run a fake-account browser workflow after reviewing persistence boundaries, cleanup controls, and whether action logs are inspectable.

### 3. [NanmiCoder/cc-haha](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/cc-haha)
- 分类：cross-platform desktop workspace for coding agents
- AI Native Product Score：90
- 做什么：Local-first desktop workspace for Claude Code and coding agents with multi-agent sessions, Git worktrees, code diffs, skill marketplace, multi-model support, computer-use, and IM/H5 access.
- 面向谁：Developers who juggle several coding-agent sessions and want native desktop controls instead of scattered terminal windows.
- AI native 点：Promotes agent sessions, worktrees, diffs, skills, messaging, and desktop computer-use into one visible operating surface.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-27 with about 14,743 stars and 8,588 forks. Root audit found desktop, adapters, runtime, native, docs, site, tests, fixtures, bin, package files, env example, release notes, AGENTS, and multilingual README docs.
- 可运行性判断：High from Electron/desktop structure, docs, tests, package files, and release-surface evidence; no desktop app, IM bridge, computer-use flow, or coding-agent session was run.
- 建议动作：Evaluate with two disposable repos and check worktree isolation, diff review ergonomics, notification routing, and task cancellation.

### 4. [agent-sh/computer-use-linux](https://github.com/agent-sh/computer-use-linux)
- 分类：Linux desktop control MCP
- AI Native Product Score：89
- 做什么：MCP server and CLI for controlling real Linux desktops through accessibility trees, screenshots, clicks, scrolls, keystrokes, GNOME/KDE/Hyprland/i3/COSMIC support, npm and crates packaging.
- 面向谁：Agent developers who need Linux GUI automation with MCP integration and desktop-environment coverage.
- AI native 点：Exposes desktop perception and actuation as a packageable MCP tool surface, with doctor commands and multiple host integrations.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-28 with about 622 stars. README audit shows CI, npm/crates badges, install, doctor, accessibility tree/screenshot/action framing; root audit saved under /tmp includes package/workspace evidence.
- 可运行性判断：High from packaging, CI badges, docs, and multi-DE command surface; no Linux desktop, MCP host, or accessibility stack was run.
- 建议动作：Test on a disposable GNOME VM with scripted before/after screenshots and explicit allowlist for apps and keystrokes.

### 5. [prasenjeet-symon/ogcode](https://github.com/prasenjeet-symon/ogcode)
- 分类：local-first agentic coding workbench
- AI Native Product Score：88
- 做什么：Self-hostable coding workbench where an agent can understand a codebase, use tools, research the web, remember decisions, plan complex work, and execute changes from a browser.
- 面向谁：Engineering teams and power users who want an open-source autonomous software-work workspace with memory, permissions, and oversight.
- AI native 点：Combines codebase context, tool use, memory, planning, browser execution, and human oversight into a local-first product surface.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-26 with about 136 stars. README calls it production-ready agentic coding workbench; root/README audit found release links, assets, self-hosting framing, model/data ownership language, and browser-based execution story.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from README, release, self-hosting, and tool/memory/permission claims; no server, browser workspace, model provider, or code-edit workflow was started.
- 建议动作：Run only against a toy repository first and inspect approval gates, memory export, rollback story, and web-research isolation.

### 6. [YUTA-fywoo/jev-gui-delegate](https://github.com/YUTA-fywoo/jev-gui-delegate)
- 分类：task-contract GUI delegation for Codex
- AI Native Product Score：87
- 做什么：Windows and Chrome GUI delegation prototype for Codex where a main model supplies goals and acceptance criteria while a local controller executes deterministic steps and calls TypeSafe Jev for semantic choices.
- 面向谁：Codex users exploring bounded GUI delegation without repeatedly asking the main model to inspect every control.
- AI native 点：Makes GUI work contract-driven: explicit scope, allowed actions, identity checks, progress save, recovery, user takeover, and outcome verification.
- 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-25 and pushed 2026-09-27 with about 131 stars. README audit shows Windows installer, install docs, changelog, validation report, task contracts, Chrome official sessions, Windows UIA, recovery, and result checking.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from installer/docs/validation evidence; no Windows UIA, Chrome session, Jev call, or task-contract run was executed.
- 建议动作：Use a public demo site first and verify that failed or uncertain submissions pause instead of replaying destructive actions.

### 7. [mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp](https://github.com/mrpulor-gh/nuphus-mcp)
- 分类：desktop automation MCP server
- AI Native Product Score：86
- 做什么：Rust MCP server for desktop automation that can control screen, windows, mouse/keyboard, and Chrome via stdio, with tooling docs and npm/crates-style packaging.
- 面向谁：Builders connecting AI agents to real desktop and browser automation through MCP.
- AI native 点：Packages low-level desktop and Chrome control as an agent-facing MCP server with explicit tool documentation and security file.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-25 with about 314 stars. Root audit found Cargo workspace, crates, npm, scripts, TOOLS docs, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, changelog, and bilingual README files.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from Rust workspace, tool docs, package directories, and security docs; no MCP client, Chrome, or desktop automation was run.
- 建议动作：Compare it against computer-use-linux on a disposable desktop and focus on tool permission boundaries plus visual-verification loops.

### 8. [graygnatconsole/mcp-audit-tool](https://github.com/graygnatconsole/mcp-audit-tool)
- 分类：MCP security audit CLI
- AI Native Product Score：85
- 做什么：Pure-Python security audit CLI for MCP server and agent configs, scanning tool poisoning, rug pulls, hardcoded secrets, command injection, and supply-chain risks with SARIF/CI support.
- 面向谁：Teams adopting MCP servers who need pre-run checks before giving agents new tool surfaces.
- AI native 点：Moves MCP trust review into repeatable CLI/SARIF/CI checks before a model ever invokes the tool.
- 增长/活跃信号：Created and pushed 2026-09-26 with about 110 stars. README audit shows install, quickstart, detection rules, GitHub Actions/CI integration, SARIF support, PyPI badge, tests, and security-centered positioning.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from package/test/CI/SARIF evidence; no real MCP config or synthetic malicious fixture was scanned.
- 建议动作：Add it to an internal MCP-server review pipeline with seeded malicious examples to measure false positives and CI usability.

### 9. [myna-recorder/myna-macro-recorder](https://github.com/myna-recorder/myna-macro-recorder)
- 分类：readable Windows macro recorder with AI assist
- AI Native Product Score：84
- 做什么：Windows macro recorder that records UI actions into editable scripts, uses image anchors, includes AI assistant-generated macros, auto-clicker, monitors, and short-job agent mode.
- 面向谁：Windows users who want understandable automation scripts and agent-assisted short desktop jobs.
- AI native 点：Bridges classic RPA/macros and AI computer-use by making recorded actions readable, editable, and monitorable.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-27 with about 88 stars. README audit shows website, Windows x64 download, free plan, visual tour, AI assistant, Script tab, auto-clicker, monitors, releases, and image-anchor positioning.
- 可运行性判断：Medium from downloadable Windows product surface and docs; no Windows installer, macro recording, monitor, or agent mode was tested.
- 建议动作：Try with a non-sensitive Windows VM and verify script readability, image-anchor brittleness, and whether AI-generated macros require review before execution.

### 10. [Finderchangchang/brewreel](https://github.com/Finderchangchang/brewreel)
- 分类：AI short-video production workflow
- AI Native Product Score：83
- 做什么：Chinese vertical promo-video generator where a product brief drives AI shot selection, copywriting, Remotion rendering, industry recipes, and ad-law checks.
- 面向谁：Small teams and creators producing vertical ads or promo videos with lower-cost models and repeatable recipes.
- AI native 点：Turns a creative brief into a reproducible agent workflow across copy, shot selection, rendering, and compliance checks rather than a one-off prompt.
- 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-26 and pushed 2026-09-27 with about 82 stars. README audit shows v0.5.1, Remotion, demo video, releases, changelog, DeepSeek Harness plugin, recipes, commercial-use framing, and docs/images.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from Remotion/plugin/release/demo evidence; no render, model call, ad-law check, or video export was run.
- 建议动作：Run one harmless product brief and compare output reproducibility, render time, and whether compliance warnings are actionable.

## Watchlist

- [YeJe-cpu/SeeCut](https://github.com/YeJe-cpu/SeeCut) — self-critiquing AI video editor skill，Score 82。Talking-head or AI-avatar video skill that finds real evidence, edits short videos, uses Gemini video review, and iterates by pairwise comparison. 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-25 and pushed 2026-09-27 with about 81 stars; README includes demo assets, release tag, multi-language docs, Gemini/Antigravity quality-loop framing. 可运行性：Medium from demos/release/docs; no media pipeline or model review was run. 建议：Watch for install simplification and deterministic asset handling before production use.
- [aaddrick/building-with-typesafe-jev](https://github.com/aaddrick/building-with-typesafe-jev) — typed-decision skill for coding agents，Score 80。Community skill teaching coding agents to use TypeSafe Jev for calibrated typed decisions and prior-art lookup. 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-26, pushed 2026-09-28, about 94 stars; README has checks badge, multilingual docs, 150+ community projects, and code sketches. 可运行性：Medium; skill/package evidence exists but it is more enablement layer than standalone product. 建议：Use as a reference for decision contracts, not a primary product candidate yet.
- [kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill](https://github.com/kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill) — logo-design agent skill，Score 78。Comprehensive logo-design skill for Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex and other coding agents with principles, SVG craft, testing tools, and a large reference library. 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-26 and pushed 2026-09-27 with about 208 stars. 可运行性：Medium-low as a skill/reference package rather than a standalone app. 建议：Keep as useful skill-library signal; promote only if it gains runnable tooling.
- [breakstageaxe61/genspark-claw](https://github.com/breakstageaxe61/genspark-claw) — agent skill pack and installer，Score 77。Community skill pack and zero-dependency installer for Genspark Claw, OpenClaw, and Hermes, with deep research, reports, slides, browser automation, and AI call prep. 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-09-26 with about 111 stars. 可运行性：Medium; installer/MCP claims need validation. 建议：Watch for real examples, tests, and host compatibility reports.
- [Core-Mate/OpenGUI](https://github.com/Core-Mate/OpenGUI) — Android GUI agent framework，Score 76。Android GUI agent framework for phone-use AI that can see, plan, and operate real mobile apps. 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-27 with about 1,806 stars from search metadata. 可运行性：Search-metadata-only in this run; no README/root audit performed. 建议：Audit mobile permission model and device-isolation story in a later run.
- [Hacker-Valley-Media/Interceptor](https://github.com/Hacker-Valley-Media/Interceptor) — browser/Mac/iPhone automation for agents，Score 75。CLI/MCP/daemon/extension/iOS bridge for signed-in browser, native macOS apps, and real iPhones. 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-26 with about 424 stars. 可运行性：Previously audited; not re-audited deeply today. High account/device risk keeps it on watchlist. 建议：Only test with disposable profiles and devices plus strict audit logs.
- [skalesapp/skales](https://github.com/skalesapp/skales) — personal cross-platform autonomous agent，Score 74。Cross-platform personal agent with coding, desktop/browser automation, scheduled tasks, voice, local LLMs, MCP, and Agent Skills. 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-25 with about 1,920 stars. 可运行性：Docs/release signal exists, but source/root product evidence was not re-audited today. 建议：Continue watching permission, local-data, and scheduled-task safety.

## Skip Reasons

- [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) — Very large mature platform; today signal is continued activity rather than new product discovery.
- [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) — Agent methodology/skill framework, useful but not a fresh standalone product surface for today.
- [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) — Major mature agent platform; not enough new 24-72h product signal for this run.
- [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) — Established workflow automation platform; AI activity is important but not a new radar discovery.
- [Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT) — Established project with broad activity; not promoted as a new product candidate today.
- [amitshekhariitbhu/ai-system-design](https://github.com/amitshekhariitbhu/ai-system-design) — Learning/course material, not a runnable AI-native product.
- [win4r/MuseAI-Skills](https://github.com/win4r/MuseAI-Skills) — Unofficial skill/runtime snapshot; archival collection rather than product workflow.
- [JoinArtisanVent/x-scraper-no-api](https://github.com/JoinArtisanVent/x-scraper-no-api) — No-API social scraping with browser-session dependence; risk profile and product value are not aligned for Top.
- [bestagentkits/motion-video-skill](https://github.com/bestagentkits/motion-video-skill) — Agent skill package with narrow surface; BrewReel/SeeCut have stronger product workflow evidence.
- [feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp](https://github.com/feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp) — Stealth/anti-bot browser automation risk; excluded from positive product ranking.

Type-level skip reasons：成熟大平台的日常活跃、课程/awesome list、prompt/skill collections、stealth scraping、纯 API/model gateway、README-only 项目、缺少独立 CLI/UI/API 的素材包、需要真实账号或设备但没有清晰权限边界的自动化。

## 今日建议动作

- 优先验证 Arcbox、Celesto、computer-use-linux：它们代表 agent execution substrate、persistent agent computer、Linux MCP desktop control 三条基础设施线。
- 对 GUI/desktop automation 候选统一要求 disposable profile/device、操作前身份核对、操作后状态核验和失败暂停。
- 把 MCP 安全评估独立出来：mcp-audit-tool 可以和 nuphus-mcp、computer-use-linux 组合成“工具接入前审计”小实验。
- 对 AI 视频工作流保持观察：BrewReel 和 SeeCut 都已经有 demo/release/docs，但需要真实 brief、素材边界、渲染成本和质量循环验证。
